🔥 Fireball & Energy Bullet Sprite Pack (Pixel Art)
-----------------------------------------------------

Includes:
- Fireball animation: 6 frames
- Energy Bullet animation: 6 frames
- Size: 32x32 px each frame
- Format: PNG, transparent background

-----------------------------------------------------
🎨 How to Use:
1. Import the sprite sheet into your engine (Unity, Godot, GameMaker, etc.)
2. Slice the sheet:
   - Frame size: 32x32 px
   - Fireball: row 1 (6 frames)
   - Energy Bullet: row 2 (6 frames)
3. Set the animation frame rate (recommend: 10–15 FPS)
4. Apply in your projectile or particle system.

-----------------------------------------------------

Enjoy creating!
